$comment: Single source of truth for the agent containers: CI image matrix (.github/workflows/build-images.yml), worker role/queue wiring (src/SecAgent.Hosting AgentCatalog), deploy loop (deploy.yml) and docker-compose. Names, queues and subscriptions mirror infra/agents.bicep (PR #3); AgentCatalogTests checks the two agree once infra/ is on the branch. imageTarget = deploy/Dockerfile target. host = which project runs it (worker = src/SecAgent.Worker with SECAGENT_AGENT=<name>; dashboard = src/SecAgent.Dashboard, secagent serve).

agents.name: intake
agents.description: SARIF / Black Duck webhook: HMAC check, raw file stored (claim check), run request enqueued.

agents.name: agent-api
agents.description: REST API, SSE live feed and dashboard (secagent serve).

agents.name: orchestrator
agents.description: Agent Framework workflow host; consumes runs and results; publishes run-events; opens PRs.

agents.name: scanner
agents.description: gitleaks, Trivy, Semgrep, binary check on one ref; canonical findings to blob; reply on results.

agents.name: triage
agents.description: Triage agent (small model tier); policy layer decides.

agents.name: verifier
agents.description: Rescan, no-new-findings check, dotnet test, evidence, short summary.

agents.name: audit-writer
agents.description: Consumes run-events (audit subscription) into the write-once evidence store.
